parsed.degree_signal: ein Studium der Data Science, Informatik, Mathematik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mit entsprechender Berufserfahrung
parsed.notes:
„Was Sie mitbringen“ sets required qualifications; „Ein Plus: Idealerweise“ makes the final qualification paragraph optional.
Cloud providers and LangChain are individually labeled despite being examples or alternatives, as directed by the guide.
Only responsibilities mention embeddings, vector databases, containers, CI/CD and monitoring; these are not labeled.
Data Science is named as a degree field, not as an independent skill requirement. Healthcare knowledge and spoken English are excluded.
The unspecified Studium maps to bachelor; the comparable qualification with professional experience is read literally as an accepted degree alternative.
General database knowledge, document processing, object-oriented programming, data structures, algorithms and software-performance understanding have no matching taxonomy entries.
